entry.name: mc.curve~
entry.description: Use the curve~ object to produce a signal that goes from an initial to target value over a specified time. It is similar to the line~ object, it produces non-linear ramps using a piecewise approximation of an exponential function.

arguments.name: initial-value
arguments.description: The first argument sets an initial value for the signal output. The default value for the parameter is 0.

arguments.name: curve-parameter
arguments.description: The second argument sets the initial curve parameter. The default value for the curve parameter is 0.

attributes.name: activeout
attributes.digest: Active Signal Output
attributes.description: Whenis 1,has a second signal outlet that outputs 1 when the ramp is active and 0 when it is not active. This signal can be connected to polyphonic voice allocator objects such asorto maintain a busy state while the line is active.can only be set as a typed-in argument to.

messages.name: anything
messages.digest: Set the target value, ramp time, and curve parameter
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number specifies a target value; the second number specifies an amount of time, in milliseconds, to arrive at that value; and the optional third number specifies a curve parameter, for which values from 0 to 1 produce an exponential curve and values from -1 to 0 produce a logarithmic curve. The closer to 0 the curve parameter is, the more the curve resembles a straight line, and the farther away the parameter is from 0, the more the curve resembles a step. In the specified amount of time,generates an exponential ramp signal from the currently stored value to the target value.In middle inlet: A list may be used to specify time in one of the Max.

messages.name: factor
messages.digest: Adjust the non-linear shaping parameters of
messages.description: The wordfollowed by a float will adjust the non-linear shaping parameters of.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set the target value to be arrived at
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is the target value, to be arrived at in the time specified by the number in the middle inlet. If no time has been specified since the last target value, the time is considered to be 0 and the output signal jumps immediately to the target value.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Set the target value to be arrived at
messages.description: In left inlet: The number is the target value, to be arrived at in the time specified by the number in the middle inlet. If no time has been specified since the last target value, the time is considered to be 0 and the output signal jumps immediately to the target value (ints are converted to floats).

messages.name: list
messages.digest: Set the target value, ramp time, and curve parameter
messages.description: In left inlet: The first number specifies a target value; the second number specifies an amount of time, in milliseconds, to arrive at that value; and the optional third number specifies a curve parameter, for which values from 0 to 1 produce an exponential curve and values from -1 to 0 produce a logarithmic curve. The closer to 0 the curve parameter is, the more the curve resembles a straight line, and the farther away the parameter is from 0, the more the curve resembles a step. In the specified amount of time,generates an exponential ramp signal from the currently stored value to the target value.In middle inlet: A list may be used to specify time in one of the Max.

messages.name: pause
messages.description: In left inlet: Pauses the internal exponential ramp but does not change the target value nor clear pending target-time-parameter triples.will continue outputting whatever value was its current value when themessage was received, until either it receives amessage or until a new ramp is input.

messages.name: resume
messages.description: In left inlet: Resumes the internal exponential ramp and subsequent pending target-time pairs if theobject was paused as a result of themessage.

messages.name: stop
messages.digest: Stop and clear the internal exponential ramp
messages.description: In left inlet: Stops the internal exponential ramp and clears pending target-time parameter triples.will continue outputting whatever value was its current value when themessage was received, resetting its target value to that value.
